newsitem.title: INDIA: India'S IRFC to raise 21.5 bln rupees in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India'S IRFC to raise 21.5 bln rupees in 97/98.

text.p: The state-run Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) has been given a target of 21.5 billion rupees ($600 million) to be raised from the domestic and international markets in 1997/98 (April-March), Railway Minister Ram Vilas Paswan said on Wednesday. He did not elaborate.

"IRFC was to raise 18.5 billion rupees from domestic as well as foreign markets during 1996/97. It has already made available approximately 15 billion rupees by the end of January 1997," he said while presenting the railway budget for 1997/98 in parliament. ($1 = 35.80 rupees)
